How we shortlist materials for a project: from mood board, to vendor visits, to physical samples on your wall.

Last week we picked finishes for a 3 BHK in Bandra: Italian quartz for the island, terracotta micro-cement for the powder room, fluted oak veneer for the TV unit. The client signed off in one sitting because we walked them through every option in their actual home, not on a screen.

This is what "transparent design process" actually looks like.

Goregaon East studio. All of Mumbai. namastedesign.in
